caption: Everyone haggles over the R15 fare. Nobody asks what it costs to keep the taxi on the road every month. What would you guess a route like mine costs?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R23 000
p/m income
Living in Ermelo
slides.body:
Male, 45
Married, kids grown and out the house
Job: Minibus taxi owner-driver, local route
Net income: R23 000 p/m

slides.title: Taxi association & route fees
slides.includes: Rank fees, route permit, association dues
slides.body: Non-negotiable if I want a spot on the rank. I've watched drivers get pushed off the route for less than a month behind on this.

slides.title: Diesel
slides.includes: Full tank most days, six days a week on the route
slides.body: The biggest number on this whole list, and it moves with the fuel price, not with what I earn.

slides.title: Insurance & tracking device
slides.includes: Third party cover, tracker for the finance company
slides.body: The bank insists on the tracker until the vehicle's paid off. Another four years of this line.

slides.title: Maintenance & tyres
slides.includes: Brake pads, taxi-spec tyres, the mechanic who knows this exact model
slides.body: This route eats brakes. I budget for a service every month whether it needs one or not.

slides.title: Driver's assistant wage
slides.includes: My gaartjie, six days a week
slides.body: He counts the fares better than I do. Worth every cent of it.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Room in Ermelo, groceries, his mother's electricity, funeral policy, taxi association welfare fund, airtime
slides.body: Six things I used to lump together as 'home money.' Split out, my mother's electricity is bigger than I want to admit.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R23 000. That's what's actually mine after the taxi's been fed first, every single day.

slides.title: I stopped guessing what the taxi actually cost me
slides.body:
I uploaded three months of statements to Beyond Horizon and it split my business costs from my own. Diesel was eating more than I'd ever added up.

No bank login needed.
